title: OmniVoice offers multilingual voice cloning and text-to-speech
friendlyTitle: OmniVoice creates speech in more than 600 languages
summary: OmniVoice is an Apache-2.0 voice-cloning and text-to-speech project covering more than 600 languages. The repository includes inference, training and optional LoRA fine-tuning support and had about 12,200 stars when reviewed.
friendlySummary: OmniVoice is an open-source tool for text-to-speech and voice cloning. It supports many languages and includes tools for training and fine-tuning.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it to prototype multilingual narration, accessibility and voice-interface workflows, or adapt a voice model with parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Voice cloning requires consent, provenance and careful controls to prevent impersonation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can test multilingual voice apps or accessibility tools. Only clone a voice when you have clear permission.
